caption: Matched 4-class spectrogram panel (orca_call, dolphin_call, humpback_song, ship_noise) -- one confirmed exemplar per class, 5s windows, v4 labels. Mel-scale log-power spectrograms, identical FFT params (2048-pt FFT, 128 mel bands, 10Hz-16kHz) and shared color scale across all four panels. Y-axis correctly labeled 'Frequency (Hz)' (binning is mel-scale, axis rendering is linear -- fixed Aug 21 2026, supersedes an earlier version that said 'Hz, mel'). Built for IEEE OCEANS 2026 poster panel 3.
notes: n_fft increased from project default 512 to 2048 to fix empty low-freq mel filters that clipped humpback content. Humpback exemplar: Oct 25 2020, MARS_20201025_175314, 135-140s -- confirmed as genuine song via 30s context after an earlier candidate was rejected (looked like a low-freq moan, possible gray/blue whale, unresolved side finding for #13).
